cases.expected: instance of Update whose question name equals "example.com."
cases.description: When a non‑null Name is supplied, newUpdate should create an Update object. The returned object must be of type Update and its question section should contain a Record whose name matches the supplied zone.

Passing a null Name should cause a NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) because the Update constructor expects a non‑null zone. The test verifies that the method fails fast for invalid input.

cases.expected: instance of Update whose question name equals "." (the root name)
cases.description: The DNS root zone is represented by Name.root. newUpdate should accept it and create an Update object whose question section contains a record with the root name.
Passing a wildcard Name (e.g., "*.example.com.") as the zone should cause IllegalArgumentException because an Update zone cannot be a wildcard.
